tex_content.html:
Lemma
[Laplacian of the square norm of a one-form] ↗ thm:levi-civita-connection

For a smooth one-form $\omega $ and its connection Laplacian, \[ rac12\Delta |\omega |^2 =\langle \Delta \omega ,\omega angle +| abla \omega |^2. \]
Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:levi-civita-connection ↗ lem:hessian-symmetric ↗ def:exponential-map ↗ lem:normal-coordinates-expansion In normal coordinates at $p$, the metric has zero first derivatives and the Christoffel symbols vanish. Twice differentiating $|\omega |^2$ using metric compatibility gives

\[ \partial _i\partial _j|\omega |^2 =2\langle abla _i abla _j\omega ,\omega angle +2\langle abla _j\omega , abla _i\omega angle . \]

Trace at $p$ to obtain the identity; tensoriality makes it global.

□
